NTMD4820N

MOSFET – Power, Dual,
N-Channel, SOIC-8
30 V, 8 A
Features
• Low RDS(on) to Minimize Conduction Losses                                                               http://onsemi.com
• Low Capacitance to Minimize Driver Losses
• Optimized Gate Charge to Minimize Switching Losses                                    V(BR)DSS                 RDS(on) Max             ID Max
• Dual SOIC−8 Surface Mount Package Saves Board Space                                                           20 mW @ 10 V
                                                                                             30 V                                          8A
Applications                                                                                                    27 mW @ 4.5 V

• Disk Drives
• DC−DC Converters                                                                                               N−Channel
• Printers                                                                                                                 D
